companions.name: Dark Roast: House Blend
companions.description: A balanced, less-black Dark Roast with burnished kiln-enamel signals for long sessions and ordinary room lighting.

intent.designRule: Dense copper, lacquer, mineral, and bottle-glass pigments stay chromatic while every informational foreground remains readable on the interactive surface.

companions.name: Dark Roast: Copper Roast
companions.description: A brighter-room Dark Roast with burnished cocoa surfaces and saturated kiln-enamel signals.

intent.designRule: High-chroma copper, gold, bottle teal, scarlet lacquer, malachite, mineral blue, and amethyst preserve hue semantics without a milk-washed palette.

companions.name: Dark Roast: Cold Brew
companions.description: A warm, positive-polarity Dark Roast for bright rooms: a cream canvas that deepens with elevation, espresso ink, and dark kiln-enamel accents that stay legible in daylight.

intent.surfaceLift: surfaces darken decisively with elevation over a cream canvas — wide ramp; light polarity needs surface separation to carry the depth that glows carry on OLED
intent.designRule: Every informational foreground stays >= 4.5:1 on the warm canvas; accents are dark and saturated rather than pale, so category color survives glare without changing clinical meaning.

companions.name: Dark Roast: Nitro
companions.description: A soft-light variation with diffused, nitrogen-infused surfaces for low-fatigue daylight coding.

companions.name: Dark Roast: Flash Chilled
companions.description: A high-chroma, cool-spectrum light mode with crisp edges and clinical contrast.

companions.name: Dark Roast: Cascara
companions.description: A botanical light mode inspired by the coffee cherry tea: a pale rose-tan canvas with deep jammy reds and dried-leaf green accents.

companions.name: Dark Roast: Velvet
companions.description: A mahogany-wine companion that trades Black Label's near-neutral canvas for visible surface chroma and plush, warm-forward accents.

intent.surfaceLift: matched to Black Label canvas luminance with roughly 2x the surface chroma
intent.designRule: Warm pigments carry the saturation while cool accents stay dusty, so the espresso identity dominates at every elevation.

companions.name: Dark Roast: Velvet Noir
companions.description: The deepest, most saturated companion: a plum-black canvas under a soft ivory foreground, tuned for low-light work.

intent.surfaceLift: the deepest canvas in the family at roughly 2.4x Black Label surface chroma
intent.designRule: A plum-black canvas carries berry-leaning warms while cool accents stay dusty, holding glare to a minimum in dark rooms.

companions.name: Dark Roast: Blue Mountain
companions.description: A deep navy canvas under a cool ivory foreground, with the family’s warm accents held against cold ground.

intent.surfaceLift: a navy canvas at roughly 3x Black Label surface chroma, lifted off pure black for long reading sessions
intent.designRule: The canvas carries the only cool mass, so warm accents stay warm and the one cool accent family is pushed cyan-ward to separate from the ground.

companions.name: Dark Roast: Night Shift
companions.description: A low-light web companion that keeps Black Label's quiet canvas while lifting only the operational surface ladder for data-dense patient census work.

intent.surfaceLift: Black Label-depth canvas with independently raised interactive surfaces
intent.designRule: Empty space remains near-black; cards and patient rows carry readable contrast. Clinical states retain House Blend's high-chroma severity palette and redundant direction cues.
